rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound: koṭi-vajra-adhika-nakha; describes the nails as exceeding millions of thunderbolts in hardness
compound with upapada: gaja-duṣprekṣa-mūrtti-dhṛk; dhṛk from √dhṛ, bearer of a form as formidable and difficult to gaze upon as an elephant

items.question: What physical attributes manifest the overwhelming power of this divine form?
premises: The nails surpass millions of thunderbolts in hardness.
The form borne is as difficult to behold as a mighty elephant.
items.inference: The divine form combines indestructible weapon-like nails with a terrifyingly formidable appearance.
uncertainties: Whether gaja-duṣprekṣa emphasizes elephant-like grandeur or a form difficult even for an elephant to face is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: He has nails harder than millions of thunderbolts and bears a form as difficult to behold as a mighty elephant.
